From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@entrustcloud.io>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: priya.shah@dexter-accelerator.org
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Request: marketplace incentive for Entrust x Dexter SI pilot

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the intro last week. Dexter and Entrust are lining up a 6-week SI-led pilot for an enterprise customer in finance (expected start Jan 11). We discussed a small marketplace-funded incentive to defray pilot consumption while the customer evaluates long-form inference, and Dexter asked if Redwood can provide partner-sourced credits that will be applied to the customer's sandbox.

High-level ask:
- $10,000 USD in trial credits allocated to the Entrust/Dexter pilot account (single-use, 90-day expiration)
- Activation window: Jan 11 — Apr 10
- Redwood to provide support telemetry for billing reconciliation and simple cost SLO guidance

Attached is the completed Entrust Trial Request Form and a short pilot scope. Dexter (cc'd) is coordinating the legal MOU. Can you advise on approval flow and timeline? We need a partner yes/no by Dec 15 to lock the customer's calendar.

Attachments: Entrust_Trial_Request_Form.pdf (application/pdf)

Cheers,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Partnerships — Entrust Cloud
liam.oconnor@entrustcloud.io
+1 415-555-0192

Subject: Fwd: Request: marketplace incentive for Entrust x Dexter SI pilot

Folks — forwarding Entrust's ask. TL;DR: $10k partner-funded credits for SI-led pilot, time-sensitive (need yes/no by Dec 15).

Key considerations I want us to confirm before we respond:
- Eligibility: Entrust is an approved marketplace partner (we have an open partner agreement; Marissa, can you confirm there are no outstanding obligations?)
- Accounting: will this be recorded against ecosystem incentives or marketing trials budget? If marketing, cc finance.
- Controls: credits should be single-use and expire after 90 days; Ben, can you confirm we can set that expiry and enable token-level reporting for the deal?

I've attached their form. If we can triage this today/Thursday we can give them a firm approval and share the DocuSign link by Friday. Vanessa, any objections to proceeding with conditional approval pending the MOU and the signed marketplace order?

[Attachment: Entrust_Trial_Request_Form.pdf]

Thanks —
Sofia

Agree with conditional approval.
- Budget: approve up to $10k from the ecosystem incentives pool (not marketing). Marissa — can you confirm remaining balance and sign-off?
- Controls: credits must be tagged to deal ENT-829 and expire after 90 days; Ben please confirm config and whether we can do consumption alerts for Entrust's sandbox.
- Legal: Partner MOU + marketplace order must be signed prior to credit activation; please route the MOU to legal if Dexter sends it to us.

I will not block this — speed matters for their timeline. If Marissa confirms budget and Ben confirms token-level telemetry, we can send an approval note to Entrust with next steps (DocuSign link + HubSpot deal update).

Liam / Priya — good news: Redwood can approve a $10,000 partner incentive for the Entrust x Dexter SI pilot. Conditions and next steps below.

Conditions:
1) Final signed Partner MOU + marketplace order referencing deal ENT-829 (we received a signed MOU draft attached in the thread).
2) Credits will be issued as a single-use trial grant, expire 90 days from activation, and will be applied to the sandbox account created for the pilot.
3) Redwood will enable token-level consumption reporting and a weekly usage summary to Entrust and Dexter (CSV export + link to the HubSpot deal).

Next steps (action owners):
- Entrust / Dexter: send signed MOU and complete the Partner Marketplace Order (Priya, please upload to the HubSpot deal or forward to legal@redwood.ai).
- Redwood (Ben): prepare DocuSign for marketplace order and create credit grant in the partner ops console once legal confirms MOU (ETA: 48 hours after MOU is received).
- Redwood (Sofia): send approval email and DocuSign link to Entrust once Marissa confirms budget availability.

Related links:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ENT-829
- Draft MOU: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake_doc/entrust-mou
